name: nf-property-transfers
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island land registration fees and business transaction levies for 2026. Use for fee-simple or Crown-lease transfers, business goodwill, consideration and market value, gifts, family or estate transfers, fee units, stamping, lodgement and assessment objections. Covers distinct charge bases, exemptions, statutory rounding, ordinary filing clocks and fictional boundary examples with primary legislation. Preserves company landholding and share-transfer uncertainties, mixed transactions, annual rates, approved fees and current tribunal procedure. Retains universal workflow outputs, source gates and unresolved country requirements; it does not establish a complete property or country pack.
